prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT the attached achievement badge proposal board. Preserve its canvas layout, Japanese header, all seven exact badge names, typography, card spacing, warm ivory background, pearly glossy enamel illustration style and palette. Do NOT redesign the entire board. Keep top-row card3 "うみはかせ賞" and top-row card4 "クイズまんてん賞" unchanged.
Make these FIVE requested edits clearly:
1. TOP ROW CARD1 "はじめのいっぽ賞": completely redesign this badge. Remove the big pink scallop and oversized pair of footprints. New silhouette: a rounded little sandy island with an ivory/gold pin rim, gentle turquoise surf along the bottom, a SMALL trail of alternating footprints leading from foreground toward a cheerful coral triangular START flag planted in the sand. No letters on flag. Small star-shaped finial atop flagpole. Simple, child-friendly, readable at thumbnail size. Warm lemon sand, aqua sea, coral flag. This symbolizes beginning the first beach adventure.
2. TOP ROW CARD2 "プラごみハンター賞": preserve existing turquoise shield, collection net containing a bottle, waves and colors. Add a cute pale-mint SEA TURTLE visibly HOLDING THE NET HANDLE with its near front flipper curled snugly around the wooden handle. Position turtle at left/top of shield, net toward right/lower area, with shell visible behind its head. Preserve net and bottle recognizability. Turtle has mint-to-teal segmented shell with ivory rim, pale spotted flippers, big friendly eyes and blush. Not a tortoise with feet. The flipper must touch and partly occlude the handle, not merely be next to it. Keep within badge card.
3. BOTTOM ROW CARD1 "ゴミたんてい賞": KEEP the existing magnifying glass design exactly: mint circular rim, blue lens containing pink scallop, plastic bottle, sparkle; coral handle diagonal down-right. Add a small happy peach HERMIT CRAB at the lower right, clearly gripping the existing CORAL HANDLE with one pincer wrapped around it. Crab carries a cream/peach spiral shell grading slightly pink-lavender, short eyestalks, tiny legs, rosy cheeks. This must still be the same magnifying-glass badge, now held by a hermit crab, NOT a replacement detective illustration. Keep the full lens content unobscured and title legible.
4. BOTTOM ROW CARD2 "ひろいもの名人賞": keep existing coral rosette, ivory center, top gold star and ribbon tails. Replace the current blue rod / claw-shaped grabber completely with unmistakable standard beach-cleanup TONGS: TWO LONG slender silver arms joined at one rounded U-shaped spring bend at their upper end, spreading slightly into a narrow V, with two broad flattened gripping tips pinching the small pink-and-white wrapper. A small aqua grip sleeve near the upper joined end may add color. Clear TWO parallel metal arms; NOT one stick with a circular claw, NOT scissors, no finger rings, no robot hand. Entire tongs diagonal within central medallion.
5. BOTTOM ROW CARD3 "そだておや賞": retain existing mint heart frame, blue smiling dolphin, mint smiling turtle, pink heart and affectionate mood. ADD a third smiling peach HERMIT CRAB with a peach/lavender spiral shell, tiny pincers and short eyestalks, so ALL THREE animals dolphin + turtle + hermit crab are clearly present together around the pink heart. Make a tidy trio, for example dolphin left, turtle upper right and crab lower right. Do not remove either original animal; retain 3 distinct faces and clear shell for crab.
Update BOTTOM RIGHT pale unearned sample to the NEW sandy-island / flag badge from card1, still pale translucent pastels with the existing progress bar and exact captions "あと すこし！" and "できたら いろが つくよ".
Keep all other text including bottom footer unchanged. No extra titles or ornaments. Preserve crisp attractive high-quality enamel finish and big rounded child-friendly shapes. This is a review proposal only.
